residuals: No same-row field-to-field comparison or arithmetic was added; expected is a constant literal.
No text/url target, cross-row implication or item identity inference was added.
Con kit opcional deliberately implies neither true nor false.
Synthetic adapter_present requires an explicit presence column; blank adapter_model cannot be treated as explicit absence.
Global form issues already consume the result; inline row controls are root-owned and must render these same pending/conflict findings without inferring observations.
Independent reference observations can still be recorded; selecting a matching reference does not override template value conditions.
Missing an entire structured field is governed by existing field-level completeness rules; value_when does not invent rows.
